name: LTL absolute minimum charge per shipment
note: ODFL absolute minimum (Item 180): interstate 699 mi or fewer $169; intrastate $151 (low); 700-1199 mi $205; 1200+ mi $255. High = ArcBest ARC 111-J absolute minimum $290 all other lanes (arcb.com ARC111-2026-08-21.pdf).
source_name: ODFL Accessorial Services brochure, tariff ODFL 100-Q

name: Liftgate service, per shipment (minimum charge)
note: Charged per cwt subject to min/max. ODFL $4.40/cwt min $115 max $330. Estes $4.95/cwt min $75 max $350 (low). XPO $13.45/cwt min $259 max $644 (high). ArcBest $12.50/cwt min $235 max $650. Value is ODFL minimum; most P&D shipments under ~2,600 lb hit the minimum (115/4.40=26 cwt).
source_name: ODFL Accessorial Services brochure, ODFL 100-Q item 891

name: Residential / limited-access pickup or delivery, per shipment (minimum)
note: ODFL limited access (residences, schools, construction sites) $7.20/cwt min $125 max $580. Estes residential $8.50/cwt min $75 max $550 (low). XPO residential $16.00/cwt min $180 max $880. ArcBest $14.50/cwt min $200 max $700 (high).
source_name: ODFL Accessorial Services brochure, ODFL 100-Q items 753-1 to 753-4

name: Inside pickup or delivery, per shipment (minimum)
note: ODFL $7.70/cwt min $125 max $605 (NYC 100-102: $16.50/cwt min $175). Estes positions not adjacent to vehicle $10.25/cwt min $100 (low). XPO $17.45/cwt min $179 max $1,504. ArcBest $18.00/cwt min $185 max $1,850 (high).
source_name: ODFL Accessorial Services brochure, ODFL 100-Q item 566

name: Redelivery after failed attempt, per shipment (minimum)
note: ODFL $7.20/cwt min $175 max $580. Estes $10.00/cwt min $85 max $900 (low). XPO $18.50/cwt min $175.50 max $553 (high). ArcBest $18.00/cwt min $155 max $750.
source_name: ODFL Accessorial Services brochure, ODFL 100-Q item 830

name: Detention with power, per hour past free time
note: Derived from per-interval tariffs: Estes $40 per 15 min = 40x4 = $160/hr (stops <20,000 lb); XPO $72.25 per 15 min = $289/hr, min $95.50 (XPO CNWY 199-AK.2 item 211); ArcBest $5.50/min = $330/hr, min $97.50 (ARC 111-J item 500).
source_name: Estes Accessorial Charges (EXLA 105 item 500)

name: Detention free time per stop
note: Free time scales with shipment weight. XPO: <1,000 lb 15 min; 1,000-4,999 lb 30 min; 5,000-9,999 lb 40 min; 10,000+ lb 60 min. ArcBest (ARC 111-J item 500): <2,500 lb 30 min ... 10,000+ lb 90 min (high). Value 0.5 hr = typical P&D shipment of 1,000-2,500 lb in both tariffs.
source_name: XPO tariff CNWY 199-AK.2 item 211

name: Vehicle furnished but not used (pickup cancelled after dispatch)
note: XPO VNU item 985 $100 per tractor/trailer. Estes item 985 $222.55 (high). ArcBest: arrived for scheduled pickup and no freight tendered $50.75 (low); trailer spotted but not used $290.63/day.
source_name: XPO tariff CNWY 199-AK.2 item 985

name: LTL fuel surcharge, % of linehaul, keyed to EIA weekly national diesel
note: Estes LTL FSC 56.0% effective 2026-10-07 at EIA national average $6.199/gal; low 39.8% (2026-07-08, $4.578); high 59.3% (2026-09-23, $6.529). Step: above $3.61/gal, +0.2 pts per 2 cents. Cross-check: ODFL Q2 2026 rev/cwt $37.84 with fuel vs $29.71 ex fuel implies FSC = 37.84/29.71-1 = 27.4% of base; Saia 27.18/20.94-1 = 29.8% (Q2 diesel was lower). Read from Estes FSC history JSON at myestes-api.estes-express.com/fuelsurcharge/history.
source_name: Estes Fuel Surcharge table (LTL/TL history)

name: Dry van spot linehaul rate per mile (ex fuel), national average
note: DAT August 2026 van spot linehaul $2.19/mi. High = July 2026 = 2.19+0.20 (release: 'fell 20 cents') = $2.39. Low = August 2025 level, derived from 'spot linehaul more than 30% higher than August 2025': 2.19/1.30 = $1.68 (upper bound for Aug 2025). All-in incl fuel, week of Aug 30-Sep 5 2026: van $2.95 (ajot.com DAT week 36). Short regional hauls usually price above the national per-mile average.
source_name: DAT press release, Sep 15 2026

name: Dry van contract linehaul rate per mile (ex fuel), national average
note: DAT August 2026: van contract $2.41. High = reefer contract $2.65 (same release). Flatbed contract derived 2.70 spot + 0.38 gap = $3.08. No published van contract range; low set equal to value.
source_name: DAT press release, Sep 15 2026

name: Truckload fuel surcharge per mile
note: DAT: van fuel surcharge averaged 70 cents/mi in August 2026, up 8 cents from July (low = 0.62). Common formula (FreightWaves): (EIA diesel - $1.25 base) / 6.5 mpg. High derived at the 2026-09-23 EIA price $6.529: (6.529-1.25)/6.5 = $0.81/mi; at 2026-10-07 price $6.199: $0.76/mi (formula source: freightwaves.com/checkpoint/fuel-surcharge-in-trucking).
source_name: DAT press release, Sep 15 2026

name: Truckload detention paid to carrier, per hour after free time
note: J.B. Hunt 360 standard: $50/hr with automated tracking updates, $40/hr manual, accrues per 15 min, max 5 hr then layover. High $100 from O Trucking guide range '$50-$100/hr after 1-2 hours free' (otrucking.com rate-confirmation guide, 2026).
source_name: J.B. Hunt 360 standardized accessorials

name: Truckload detention free time
note: J.B. Hunt: 2 hours after arrival check call. ATRI defines detention as >2 hours at the facility; drivers detained at 39.3% of stops in 2023 (truckingresearch.org 2024-09). Low 1 hr from O Trucking guide ('after 1-2 hours free').
source_name: J.B. Hunt 360 standardized accessorials

name: Layover, per day
note: J.B. Hunt: $250/day with automated updates, $150/day manual (low); no detention paid at the same stop. High $300 from O Trucking '~$150-$300/day after 24 hours'.
source_name: J.B. Hunt 360 standardized accessorials

name: Truck ordered not used
note: J.B. Hunt: $200 with location services on, $150 off (low). High $300 from O Trucking 'dry van often ~$150-$300; specialized higher'.
source_name: J.B. Hunt 360 standardized accessorials

name: Spot minus contract linehaul rate, dry van
note: DAT August 2026: van spot $2.19 vs contract $2.41 = -$0.22 (-9.1% of contract: 0.22/2.41); reefer -$0.04; flatbed -$0.38 (low; contract above spot all summer). High +$0.13 = reefer July 2026 (spot above contract). Van was 'roughly even' in July.
source_name: DAT press release, Sep 15 2026

name: Local container move, Chicago rail ramp to warehouse within 25 mi, 40ft dry, base
note: Base rate range $175-$270, value = midpoint (175+270)/2. Excludes fuel (22%), chassis split $25-$40, after-hours pickup $50-$100, extended region $75-$200. Page says benchmarks are estimates.

note: ArcBest: 'Dry Runs will be subject to a full additional drayage charge for each occurrence.' So TONU = rate_per_load; values copied from the DrayLocator Chicago rail range (175-270, midpoint 222.5).

name: Contractor settlement per truck-day, 26ft box truck + 2-person crew, appliance/furniture
note: Hub Group Final Mile posting: 'Gross up to $3,500 per week per truck' / 5 days = $700/day (a ceiling, not an average). J.B. Hunt Final Mile postings (Glassdoor listing): $700-$800/day typical, $775 average quoted, $1,000/day on two-day overnight routes (high).
source_name: Hub Group Final Mile contractor posting (cdljobnow)

name: Contractor revenue per stop, white-glove 2-person
note: Derived: J.B. Hunt posts $700-$800/day at 12-14 stops/day. 750/13 = $58; low 700/14 = $50; high 800/12 = $67. This is what the carrier is paid per stop, not what the retailer charges the consumer.
source_name: J.B. Hunt Final Mile contractor postings (Glassdoor listing)

name: Attempted delivery / consignee not ready, per attempt
note: Averitt White Glove Rules Tariff item 150: $75 per shipment per attempt. Same tariff: reconsignment $75 min, $5.25/cwt, $350 max. Tariff dated 2019; no newer published final-mile schedule found.

Plus FSC; extra weight $0.05/lb; van bulk +$20; dedicated ASAP $2.00/mi car, $2.50/mi van. Scheduled-route contract cross-check: WI State Lab of Hygiene courier pays $42.10-$70.20 per stop (bussvc.wisc.edu 5208pricing.pdf).

name: Lumber/building-supply delivery charge per delivery (when under free-delivery minimum)
note: Ricci Lumber: flatbed/pickup $15 local to $50 under 35 mi, free over $750-$3,500 order value; value = <20 mi $35. High = boom truck first 30 min under 35 mi $110 (local $75). Beyond 35 mi: $1.50/mi flatbed, $3.00/mi boom. Delivery is usually bundled into material price above the minimum, so most stops carry $0 explicit delivery revenue. Schedule revised 12/2015; no newer published yard schedule found.
source_name: Ricci Lumber Delivery Policy & Charges

name: Boom truck time past first 30 minutes, per hour
note: Ricci Lumber: boom truck $150/hr pro-rated to next 30 min, after the first 30 min included in the delivery charge.
source_name: Ricci Lumber Delivery Policy & Charges

name: Free wait/unload time per jobsite stop
note: Curri: extra charge when the driver waits more than 30 min (smaller vehicles) or more than 60 min (box trucks and larger, high). Amount not published.
source_name: Curri Help Center, charges for additional delivery requirements

name: Delivery cost carried per stop, route distributor (embedded in product margin)
note: Derived from an unaudited vendor example: '25-truck beverage operation spending $80,000 monthly on delivery costs', drivers do 15-20 stops/day. 80000/25/21.7 workdays = $147/truck-day; /17.5 stops = $8.4; low /20 = $7.4; high /15 = $9.8. Route distributors rarely invoice delivery; revenue is product margin. WEAK: $147/truck-day is below one driver's daily wage, so the source likely omits labor. Placeholder only.
source_name: Zeo Route Planner blog (beverage delivery costs)

name: Detention free time, industry definition (fallback)
note: ATRI: driver detention = more than two hours at a customer facility; 39.3% of stops detained in 2023; $3.6B direct cost, $11.5B lost productivity. Segment rows override this one.
source_name: ATRI, Driver Detention Impacts on Safety and Productivity

name: Detention rate per hour (fallback)
note: J.B. Hunt standard $50/hr ($40 manual), O Trucking range $50-$100/hr (otrucking.com). Segment rows override this one.
